text: HEINEKEN Việt Nam: High-quality investment drives long-term competitiveness
Bloomberg recently highlighted Việt Nam as a notable growth market for the global beer industry.
Having been part of Việt Nam's growth story for 35 years, what does this mean for HEINEKEN?
For HEINEKEN, Việt Nam is an important market where we have invested in expanding our operations, driving innovation and developing local capabilities over the past 35 years.
We believe HEINEKEN Việt Nam can only succeed if Việt Nam succeeds, meaning our growth must go hand in hand with the country's development.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we will continue to prioritise high-quality investment in technology, innovation and people development.
This means building capabilities not only within our business but also across the wider value chain.
In doing so, our investments help strengthen local capabilities and support more efficient and sustainable growth.
At the same time, Việt Nam is an important learning market for HEINEKEN globally.
Innovations, expertise and best practices developed here can be shared and scaled across our global network.
You often speak about 'growing with Việt Nam'.
How has this commitment been reflected in HEINEKEN Việt Nam's 35-year journey?

For us, growing with Việt Nam means building a long-term presence, contributing to the country's economic development and creating opportunities for the people and businesses connected to our value chain.
Since establishing our first brewery in HCM City in 1991, we have steadily expanded our operations and strengthened our local roots.
Today, HEINEKEN Việt Nam operates five breweries, employs nearly 3,000 people and supports 167,000 jobs across its value chain.
In 2025, we spent nearly VNĐ22 trillion on local sourcing and contributed more than VNĐ27 trillion to the State budget.
Our overall contribution to the economy was equivalent to 0.5 per cent of Việt Nam's GDP.
Beyond these figures, our journey is also reflected in the growth of our partners.
Minh Quang, one of our distributors in HCM City, is a case in point.

Over more than three decades of partnership with HEINEKEN Việt Nam, it has grown from a small family-run grocery store into a business employing around 250 people and operating three distribution warehouses, serving approximately 700 retail outlets.
As we mark 35 years in Việt Nam, we look forward to continuing this journey and creating lasting value for our business, our partners and the communities in which we operate.

As Việt Nam seeks to attract high-quality foreign direct investment (FDI) in line with Resolution No. 10-NQ/TW, how is HEINEKEN Việt Nam investing in production capabilities, local talent and innovation?
For us, high-quality FDI is measured not only by the capital invested but also by the capabilities and opportunities it creates for Việt Nam.
At HEINEKEN Việt Nam, this means combining advanced manufacturing technologies with investment in local talent and stronger domestic partnerships.
Our Vũng Tàu Brewery is a good example.
As one of HEINEKEN's largest breweries in Asia Pacific, it showcases our advanced manufacturing capabilities and commitment to resource efficiency.
Equally important, our Vietnamese teams have developed the expertise to independently operate, maintain and continuously improve these modern production systems.
In 2025, they contributed 28 best practices in water and energy savings to HEINEKEN's global network.
The brewery also supports the wider industrial ecosystem, working with 46 associated businesses and supporting more than 200 indirect jobs.
We extend this commitment beyond our own operations.

Through our strategic partnership with the HCM City University of Technology, under Việt Nam National University-HCM City, we help equip students with practical knowledge and skills in advanced manufacturing, data analytics and automation, preparing them to contribute to Việt Nam's growing technology and industrial sectors.
Sustainability is central to HEINEKEN Việt Nam's business.
How is the company's sustainability strategy contributing to the country's development goals?
We remain committed to 'Brewing a Better Việt Nam' through three pillars: responsible consumption, the environment and social impact.
Sustainability is central to the way we run our business, helping us build resilience and support long-term growth.

Under the responsible consumption pillar, we have worked with relevant authorities, including the traffic police, for 15 years to promote the message 'When You Drive, Never Drink' and encourage safe behaviour on the roads.
Under the environmental pillar, water stewardship remains a key priority.
Our public-private partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, WWF-Việt Nam and local partners is central to our efforts to conserve water resources.
By the end of 2025, we had achieved 100 per cent water balance at our breweries in Hà Nội, HCM City and Tiền Giang (now part of Đồng Tháp Province).
We are now expanding the programme to the Cu Đê and Ray-Đá Đen river basins, with the ambition of balancing 100 per cent of the water used in our products across all five breweries by 2030.
In terms of social impact, we continue to work with local communities and stakeholders to create meaningful, lasting value.
We believe effective partnerships among businesses, government and communities are essential to addressing shared challenges.
Looking back on HEINEKEN Việt Nam's 35-year journey, what priorities will guide the company's next phase of growth?
Looking ahead, we remain committed to growing with Việt Nam and supporting the country's ambitions, including achieving double-digit economic growth and advancing sustainable development.
We will continue to strengthen our production capabilities, drive innovation and invest in our people and partnerships to support our next phase of growth.
As we reflect on our 35-year journey, we remain guided by the belief that our business can only thrive when the economy, people and communities around us thrive.
This belief will continue to shape HEINEKEN Việt Nam's journey in the years ahead.-VNS
